_about: Tables for body/PSYCHOLOGY.md. This file never defines a meter: every row pushes a meter that already exists in PIRATE.md 7/7a or STATS.md 3/4/5 (mood, madness, hearts, respect, the sliders, trust, the relationship web). Pushes are per overnight tick unless the row says per event. mark: rex | proposed | open.

pushes.title: Body and social states and the existing meters they push
pushes.source: Mechanisms are established psychology (sleep loss raises irritability and emotional reactivity; pain and hunger lower mood and patience; alcohol disinhibits; isolation and bereavement lower mood; fear is contagious in groups), PSY-*; the sizes are placeholders. The meters are Rex's (PIRATE.md 7, STATS.md 3 to 5).
rows: snaps at a crew mate; short answers on keywords
toward Volatile, +0.5 a day (slow, as Rex's sliders move)
and madness +1 a day for a character whose trigger is being pushed

-1 per meal missed; -2 a day while over 0.8
'could eat a horse'; steals from the stores (madness trigger for some)
rex (hunger hits mood), proposed (size; the split, Rex's go-ahead 2026-10-29)

madness_links.title: Body states as madness triggers (per type; the story keeper owns the triggers themselves)
madness_links.source: Rex: each crew mate has a madness with its own meter; things they hate push it up; past a line they act, the way the type's inferior function erupts (PIRATE.md 7; crew/ROSTER.md). This table only says which body states are plausibly a trigger, for the story keeper to keep or drop per character.
rows: types whose slight is 'left out' or 'cheated'
the careful, clean types (the ISTJ bosun)
the loyal, the jealous, the possessive
everyone with a trigger: drink lowers the line by 10 for the night
